I made Papa a drawing before he went out to sea! It has Papa holding a paddle, Mama smiling, and me holding a small red dragonfly... I hid it carefully in a memory crystal. Look near the flowers!
Before Papa untied the rope, I slipped a paper sketch into his woven bag so he wouldn't feel lonely out on the big water. Do you see a paper drawing glowing over there?
I remember drawing our happy family with wax crayons... Papa folded it gently and put it near his heart. That drawing is waiting to be found right nearby!
My picture had a big smiling sun and our little bahay kubo! Papa said it was the most beautiful artwork in the whole barangay. Look close by—the drawing is shining!
Mama always says Papa carried my drawing everywhere he went. Even in the middle of the storm, he held on to the memory of our home. Look over there for my drawing!
